reviews.conclusion: This interval is after the finish: player enters the End exit, then black/dirt credits with Minecraft logo, then returns to the overworld. The visible SpeedRunIGT stays fixed at RTA 08:13.283 and IGT 08:00.384 during the transition and returned overworld. Credits transition bounds 7.5-8.0 s contain the 7.667 s deficit. Treat as post-finish credits, not an unexplained in-run deficit.

Exact deficit attribution is unresolved at this sampling rate; no inference of an anomalous client clock.
Visible settings/video-settings visit spans proxy transition bounds 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with 1.200 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
